comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked against a measured table: a joint return with both W-2s at 8,000, a claimable spouse, the couple not required to file and filing only for a refund. Line 12 is 16,450 (earned income + 450; 31,500 unclaimed) and line 33 is the 600 withheld alone (the EITC of 649 is not allowed).
